uncertainty: Reuse original predeclared intervals only; no new significance tests or resampling. All new subgroup and rank-budget analyses are exploratory.
ranking_ties: AP uses complete tied-score threshold groups. Fixed-budget ranking uses sample_id to break ties deterministically within each outer fold.
scope: CPU arithmetic on saved predictions, calibration records, learning curves, fit checks and metadata. No model loading, training, fresh inference, feature extraction, raw-data access, corruption experiments or follow-up execution.
data_domain: REASSEMBLE completed-action failure classification; no new PHM data analysis
duplicate_policy: Reject duplicate assessment sample keys; preserve all existing files and records.
follow_up: Recommendation only; any new scientific run requires a separate decision.
